title: King's Ransom
start: Talk to Gossip, outside Sinclair Mansion.

items.t: Granite (any size), or a ring of stone
Telekinetic Grab runes (1 air rune and 1 law rune, can be obtained during the quest) and the standard spellbook
Animate rock scroll (required to bring if you have it in your bank, otherwise Wizard Cromperty will give you one during the quest)

recommended.t: Ardougne, Falador, and Camelot teleports could be useful
Weight-reducing equipment such as the boots of lightness could come in handy
Skull of Remembrance, for a quick teleport to the Black Knights' Fortress

rewards.t: 5000 Magic XP lamp (Skill level must be 45 or higher)
5000 Skill XP lamp (Skill level must be 50 or higher)
33000 Defence XP lamp (Skill level must be 65 or higher)
The hair clip (a more durable version of the lockpick) if obtained during quest
Access to the Knight Waves training ground
Access to the Court Cases Distraction and Diversion

steps.t: Talk to the Gossip south of the Sinclair Mansion (Fairy ring CJR). [Chat: Accept]
Talk to the Guard inside the gates.
From the outside, break the eastern smashed window of the mansion (right click to choose break).

sub.t: You might have to try again because of the dog

steps.t: Once inside, go to the large room and take the scrap paper next to the fireplace.
p: The contents of the scrap paper.

steps.t: Go up to the floor 2.
Take the address form from the table in the central northern room and read it.
Search the nearby bookcase for a black knight helm.
Go back down the staircase and "break" the smashed window again to climb out.

Talk to the Guard three times. [Chat: 1 I have proof that the Sinclairs have left.] [Chat: 1 I have proof that links the Sinclairs to Camelot.] [Chat: 1 I have proof of foul play.] (you can click away after giving the items to skip the first 2 interactions)
Talk to Gossip. [Chat: 3 Tell me about Anna Sinclair.]
Go to the Seers' Village Courthouse, directly south from the mansion gates.
Talk to Anna. [Chat: 1 Okay, I guess I don't have much of a choice.]
Dismiss any followers you might have and go down the stairs to begin the trial. [Chat: 1 Yes, I'm ready.]
Call the dog handler as a witness [Chat: 2 Dog handler], talk to Pierre. [Chat: 2 Ask about the thread › 3 Ask about the poison]

sub.t: You may need to resize your interface and zoom out before descending the stairs since he appears near the bottom of the screen.

steps.t: For the following options, talk to the judge to call a witness, then choose who you would like to call:

sub.t: Call the butler [Chat: 3 Butler], talk to Hobbes. [Chat: 1 Ask about the dagger]
Call the maid [Chat: 4 Next page › 2 Maid], talk to Mary. [Chat: 4 Ask about the night of the murder]

steps.t: After the balloons drop, exit via the gate.
Talk to Anna in her cell.
Go to the northeast of Camelot Castle, outside of the castle hedges
Search the statue.
Talk to Merlin. [Chat: 3 What do we do now? › 1 Reclaim Camelot. › 2 Retrieve the Holy Grail. › 3 Save King Arthur.]
Reach the vent on the northern wall, it should trigger a cutscene in which the imprisoned knights lift Merlin out. Do not reach for the vent again afterwards.

sub.t: If you don't see a cutscene, then talk to Merlin again and exhaust all options.

steps.t: Cast Telekinetic Grab on the guard fixing his hair outside your cell door. Ask the knights around if you didn't bring any Telekinetic Grab runes.

sub.t: Drop trick will work here if you would like an extra hairclip.

p: Anna Sinclair in the court jail.

steps.t: Use the hairclip on the metal door.
Complete the puzzle.

sub.t: To complete this puzzle, you must set each of four tumblers to the correct height. The most foolproof way to do this (although not necessarily the quickest) is to set all tumblers to the lowest height and try the lock.
If a tumbler shows a green circle, do not change that tumbler anymore.
For the remaining tumblers, they will each show a blue or red circle. Increase those tumblers height by one and try again.
Continue until the lock unlocks. This method will take at most six attempts.

steps.t: Once you have bypassed the gate, climb up two sets of staircases to reach the top floor.
Search the table and click the purple cylinder second from the right.
Go to East Ardougne, northeast corner, and talk to Wizard Cromperty. [Chat: 1 Talk about King's Ransom]
Equip your bronze med helm and iron chainbody and unequip other equipment, then enter the Black Knights' Fortress from Edgeville.

sub.t: If you have the Skull of Remembrance, you can teleport to the floor 3 of the fortress and head down to the floor 0.

p: The statue that hides a path into Camelot.
In jail, with the Camelot residents.
The jail guarded by the Black Knights.

steps.t: Climb-down the ladder in the south-west corner.
Remove your bronze helm and iron chainbody, then free King Arthur.
Talk to King Arthur. Give him the bronze helm and iron chainbody.
Return to Camelot and talk to King Arthur.
Quest complete!
